name: Welcome to the Fold — with the madness cost paid and X = 3, a creature with toughness 3 is taken
notes: Last open cast-condition card (2026-10-07). "Gain control of target creature if its toughness is 2 or less. If this spell's madness cost was paid, instead gain control of that creature if its toughness is X or less." was an unconditional gain-control. The control effect now carries a condition on the target's toughness as the spell resolved (the spell's cast-time states, _castStates), against 2, or against X when the "Madness cost paid" toggle is on. Madness toggle on, X = 3: Hill Giant 3/3 changes controller.
